design_philosophy: A professional, technical, and highly precise UI tailored for road construction engineers. It avoids 'startup' fluff and focuses on CAD-like efficiency, readability under bright outdoor light, and clear data hierarchy.

spacing_and_layout.floating_panel: absolute top-4 left-4 z-50 p-4 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#DEE2E6] shadow-sm rounded-sm min-w-[200px]
spacing_and_layout.top_toolbar: absolute top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 p-1 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#DEE2E6] shadow-sm rounded-sm
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: absolute top-0 right-0 h-full w-80 bg-white border-l border-[#DEE2E6] shadow-xl z-40 flex flex-col
spacing_and_layout.status_bar: absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-8 bg-[#212529] text-white flex items-center justify-between px-4 z-50 text-xs font-mono

components.card: bg-white border border-[#DEE2E6] rounded-sm p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer
components.badge: px-2 py-1 bg-[#212529] text-white font-mono text-xs rounded-sm

accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='project-card-01', data-testid='tool-zoom-in')

image_urls.description: Asphalt road construction workers. Use as a subtle faded background for the 'No projects yet' empty state in the dashboard.
Blueprint technical drawing. Use as default thumbnail image for project cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard ('Moje Projekty') as the entry route. Use a clean grid layout with the 'card' component styles.
The canvas workspace route should take up 100vh/100vw, hiding standard scrollbars (overflow-hidden).
Implement the interactive canvas using HTML5 Canvas or an SVG overlay on top of a pannable/zoomable div container.
The grid must be visible, with a default 0.5m scale. Implement visual lines that scale and translate with the zoom/pan state.
Floating Measurement Panel (top-left) should show the current active polygon's live area in m².
Sidebar (right) should list all created areas with their MM/YY/XXXX ID.
Status bar (bottom) should display real-time cursor coordinates (X, Y), Zoom %, and Grid Step (0.5m).
Crucial: Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, canvas elements, tools, and project cards.
Use Shadcn UI components for buttons, dialogs, cards, but heavily customize them to match the technical, sharp 'rounded-sm' style. Use .js files, not .tsx.
